name: SA Youth Week
shortDescription: An annual South Australian celebration featuring activities created by and for young people aged 12 to 25.
plainEnglishSummary: SA Youth Week offers activities where young people can connect, participate and celebrate their ideas, talents and contributions.
availabilityNote: SA Youth Week 2026 has finished. Information about SA Youth Week 2027 will be published when available.
eligibilityNote: Activities and participation requirements may vary. Check the official event information or contact the relevant event organiser before attending.
